Pilots demand government curb SpiceJet flights and scrutinize ₹5,500‑crore fundraise

India’s Federation of Indian Pilots has asked the government to restrict SpiceJet’s flight operations unless the airline can demonstrate sufficient resources for safe operations, citing a number of grounded aircraft and delayed salary payments, and calling for scrutiny of SpiceJet’s planned ₹5,500‑crore fundraising; the pilots’ union ALPA India has also raised concerns about flight safety, staff welfare and regulatory oversight, and has urged the Directorate General of Civil Aviation to take strict action.
